authorization: All source kinds default-off: future admission requires exact named IDs, content_secret_scans=true, selectors and explicit native scopes. No API-key/listKeys/grants/ingestion/write or auth fields added. Pure exported selected_targets rejects customer/App IDs, arbitrary queries/URLs, unknown tables, duplicates and foreign scopes.
final_node_id_receipt: native-final.xml contains all exact244 node IDs; per-surface families above are parametrized on actual native table names.
identity_window: Authenticated tenant verified separately from native subscription and selected resource; native customerId/AppId derived only from bound resource GET. Query window has fixed absolute start/end, one hour, descending typed rows, in-window extrema, and snapshot created_at within native deadline. Consumer checks receipt host/method/audience/capture/target binding, scan-local credential+customer provenance, selection, whole selected profile completeness and shared row count.
limitations: Sample clean PASS covers only returned nonempty messages from the fixed preceding hour; it proves neither all rows in that hour nor full history, ingestion, delivery, runtime behavior or credential validity.

Only AppTraces.Message, FunctionAppLogs.Message and Application Insights traces.message are supported. Other tables/columns, custom dimensions, exceptions, cross-subscription source rows, additional applications/workspaces, result paging, sovereign/custom hosts are unsupported.

Underlying credential SDK owns authentication transport timeouts/OAuth retries.12calls bounds selected native GET/POST operations and120s is checked around token acquisition/read/scanning, not a hard wall-clock cancellation of an in-flight SDK authentication call. No live OAuth/role grant/network reachability is tested.

Workspace-specific granularity/access modes and protected-table rules apply; metadata-only custom role does not imply query access, whereas built-in Reader can already include read query privileges. No default role grants are suggested.
Application Insights error-bearing200 partial tables are unsupported without an independently verified native partial-success contract; no fake positive support is claimed.
The current production modules/registry/server/frontend/canonical files were not edited; root admission and exact formatter/help integration remain pending.
privacy: Raw rows/values/error text/auth never enter generic request caches or exported metadata. Native metadata credentials/keys are discarded without scans. HMAC value dedup coalesces repeated hits across rows/profiles. New ledger merges before unchanged declaration/five-reader final union, using existing configuration_secret_redactions/remember callback and bounded cleanup; late aliases, secret-error bodies and overflow withholding tested.
proof: Independent native GET/POST bytes through actual AzureTransport.token, azure.collect scheduler/scan-local provenance and public collect_snapshot/evaluate_snapshot. Candidate hooks and registry are explicit test-local proposals, not production admission. Generic cached AzureTransport.request is hard-blocked. Both actual pinned Kingfisher1.4.0/TruffleHog3.92.5 used for clean/hit samples and one-engine-missing positives; no CASES as native input.9 source-bound captures replay in a fresh process.

root_hooks.auth: Existing AzureTransport.token SDK credential may acquire fixed Logs/ApplicationInsights audience; existing logs_token only applies Log Analytics. No new auth fields, grants, API keys or ingestion access.
root_hooks.collector: Add source.KINDS to TYPES/default exclusions; pure selected_targets validation before auth; source.collect after declaration job before credential/customer provenance loop; merge log_sample_secret_metadata before source.final_snapshot delegates unchanged declaration/five-reader union.
root_hooks.engine: Exact named ID->kind gating plus content_secret_scans, combined4-target validator and default/bulk exclusions; overwrite internal kind spoof; no category/framework authorization.
root_hooks.hosted: Allow only2 new selector names and pure Azure-only selected_targets; no customerId/AppId, arbitrary query, URL, token audience or new API-key/bearer fields accepted.
root_hooks.metadata_help: Use standalone docs/peaso-azure-selected-log-samples.md, explicit fixed hour/100row sample-only scope, per-table permission/access-mode distinctions, unavailable/empty/partial UNKNOWN.
root_hooks.registry: After acceptance, atomic exact source/fixture+typed function/_evaluate admission; new native CASES only; Secrets/high and empty numbered requirement edges.
